Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, I suppose I could just skip to the epilogue, sir. Hmm. Having signed the peace accord, the happy wanderers returned to their village as heroes. The rain stopped, and Candavere kept her date with Jeremiad. As they danced, she was as happy as a young girl could be. Especially as she was now back to normal. (Candavere spits out fire) Well, almost. But even as the heroes recalled their tales of glory, the evil Malifishmirtz slipped away, bent on laying the groundwork for a sequel. (Malifishmirtz escapes from his pillory) But for now, all was right with the world, and everyone in the village agreed that it was the best Midsummer Wode-Gathering Harvest Bonfire's Eve ever. Certainly the first one to have ten thousand monsters. The End. How was that, sir?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, hi, Agent P. Major Monogram isn't here right now, but he left this note. (Tries to mimic Major Monogram's voice) "Dear Carl, I haven't been kidnapped so don't come looking for him... I mean me." Kinda weird, though, that he took the time to cut each letter out of a magazine. Anywhos, Doof is on vacation with his daughter in Tokyo right now which is where the Annual World Good Guy convention is being held, and Major Monogram's the keynote speaker. Coincidence? 100% yes! So I guess you got the day off!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: You're right! (to the goat) Agent G, quit eating those memos and get out into the field! (to the dog) Agent D, go see what you can dig up! (to the owl) Agent O, go find out who's who! Agent Possum, play dead! (Agent Possum does so.) Excellent! (To the bear who is shredding documents) Agent B, go into the woods and...see what's out there! And the rest of you, get out there and fight evil! Agent P, I want you to go out to City Hall and get a reading on the situation there and report back to me.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, Agent P? Hey, it's me: Carl. The intern? We got a bit of a situation here. Major Monogram has been frozen like this pretty much all day. Solid as a rock. (Knocks on Monogram, knocking him over) Oh, sorry. Anywho, if the Major were able to, I'm sure he'd say, well, "Ouch", first of all, am I right? (Laughs) But seriously, I'm sure he'd say "Doofenshmirtz was up to something, and you should get to the bottom of it". (To Major Monogram) Am I right? Sir?

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: (Still at the Flynn-Fletcher house) Let's see, red petals, three golden pistils... Dendrobium uncharticum. Presumed to exist only in uncharted regions in... Africa? I was sure he was struck with the Go Home-inator. We didn't even have a Go to Africa-inator. No matter; soon his tiny hand print will be mine, and then the OWCA will be mine, and then the Tri-State Area will be mine, and then I'm totally getting extra credit.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Dressed as Major Monogram, Mimicking his voice) Hello, Agent P. Welcome to the Company Halloween Party. Try the punch, it's wicked good. Just be sure to use a coaster. Certain people can be downright persnickety. (Normal voice) Psst, Agent P, it's me, Carl! Had you fooled, didn't I? I've got the monobrow, the whiskery mustache, but I couldn't get both my eyes on the same side of my nose. He's like a Picasso, or something.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Look, if you guys can't pass this training exercise, there's no way you'll complete "Town Square Riot", "Freeway Assault", or "Escape the Ancient Ruin". Agent P, your trainees need to learn how to work together as a team or they're never gonna earn their black hat bands. And, uh, Karen? (takes out a laser pointer and points it at Karen, who is chasing a butterfly) Karen the Cat. Pay attention. Karen, I'm over here.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: I'm over my minutes. But, now, with the boundless power of the mighty OWCA computer, I will bring the Tri-State Area to its knees! I will stop the power stations, de-synchronize all the traffic lights, and yeah! I'll have a vast army of interns do all my bidding, each one of them paid!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: It's intel from Agent Squab, French surveillance pigeon. Hmm, there's a small shift in ambient temperature, there's civil unreasonableness at City Hall, and L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. is convening for a secret meeting?! Oh no! Why did this have to happen on my watch?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm worried too, sir. So I thought I'd make myself useful by modifying his chair. I added a hidden button so the chair will automatically go to Doofenshmirtz's. Then automatically return here. (laughs) Everything's Agent P sized here. It's kinda cute, like kindergarten.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Voilà, monsieur! (He shows a wristwatch) This first item is our new wrist-communicationizer. It has many applications that will help you in the field. For example, a powerful directional electro-magnet. It will draw any metal object to you. (He pushes a button and his glasses are drawn to it) See? And these are aluminum!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I-Is this thing on? I want to thank you all for taking some time outta your busy schedules to attend our compulsory O.W.C.A. Animal Sensitivity Seminar. However, if you currently are an animal, you may be excused to your missions.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: (He comes walking in stroking a skull in his hand) Looks like I got two for one. I'm going to take over the Tri-State Area, and with my administrators access to OWCA's supercomputer, and my intimate knowledge of proper photocopying techniques, I'm just the unpaid stooge to do it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: He wrote a letter by hand then put it in an envelope and sent it through the regular mail with a stamp and everything. Who does that? And it's scented. (smells envelope) Mmm, Milbank Nights. One of the better perfumes to come out of South Dakota.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: Bah! I'll have to untangle this mess myself. The heat signature is wrong on the Disintegrat-inator. The angle is too obtuse for the Derezz-inator. The Julienn-inator isn't plugged in. And the Overhang-inator is just plain dumb.

Name: Carl
Dialog: ...Of course, you'll only need this if you're attacked by one of the royals or a member of Parliament, so it's probably okay to leave the safety on. And here's your brand new rocket-car. (He shows it as Perry gets in and starts it) Sweet huh? Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: Why, hello, Agent P. Just wanted to catch up a bit. We never get any time to talk! In fact, we should totally get together in person. Considering that you're in such a lovely region with one-of-a-kind flowers...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent P, nowhere in the O.W.C.A. training manual does it say, "Abandon your team and apprehend the suspect by yourself." You're not a lone wolf anymore. Your team lacks focus and they need your leadership.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent P, (spills the drink on Perry's tux) how could you have turned to the dark side? How could you have forsaken all that's good and right to be that maniac's butler? You don't belong in that uniform! You belong in this hat! (Carl takes Agent P's fedora and puts it on Perry's head, who looks at it, confused.) See?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Huh? Oh, yeah. Huh. (Beep; Clears throat) Doofenshmirtz has been purchasing some suspicious items: Bags of sand; an extra-long shoelace. We know he's up to no good. Get out there and see what he's up to. (To Major Monogram) How was that?

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz?! Great googly moogly! I thought he'd given up his evil ways when we placed him as a high school science teacher. Well, it's too bad Monogram isn't around to see this.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Monty, Monty. Walk with me. You know your dad is my superior. I'm obliged to tell him everything. I can't imagine what could possibly sway me to consider such a dereliction of duty.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I even have to pay for my own parking at OWCA! This internship is actually costing me money! (He sits down and leans against the wall.) I love this job, but if I keep having to work like this, even in my off-hours, I—

Name: Carl
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz kept coming down and grabbing pieces of his old Inators from cardboard boxes. Oh no, brown recluse spider's favor dwelling in cardboard! (Major Monogram touches him in the ear; He shrieks) Get it off! Get it off!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yeah! With everyone in costume there'll be no baleful looks of judgement. (Picks up Perry's fedora) Hey, this is Agent P's hat. There must be something wrong. (Calls Monogram through his wrist communicator) Major Monogram, we have a problem. (Shows Perry's fedora to Major Monogram) Look!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I've been building robotic replicas of the Flynn-Fletcher family. We can get Agent P to operate the Mr. Fletcher robot, until we can replace him with the real Mr. Fletcher!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz just downloaded these plans for an anti-gravity fun launcher. But when I run that through the anagram decoder, the letters form "Evil Fanatic Hunt R Raygun".

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Begins reading) Devote your mind to this tale of the distant past, and the adventures that did befall the most noble of knights. (Scene ripples into a scene of a medieval cottage) Where stood the cottage of the humble antique dealer...

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Imitating Major Monogram) Ahh, Agent P! Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been to every plant-nursery in town, buying up little seedlings and now he's out and about in his blimp. Find out what he's up to!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Y-You don't understand. I do all the work at the agency, but he doesn't even acknowledge me. I mean that's all I want, a simple "Thank you" is that too much to ask?

Name: Carl
Dialog: From the top of another hill, a figure appears, a shaft of light shining off his auburn hair. It was Carl, the Red-headed Paladin from the land of Internius. He--

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm patching in all the agents now, sir. We couldn't afford the rights to that famous birthday song, so the agents and I came up with this. (various O.W.C.A. agents appear on the monitor in separate boxes, Carl blows a pitch pipe) A one, a two, a three.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: Sorry about your friends, Agent P. I'm evil, what can I say? (Perry looks around) Oh, the new robots. Yeah, I had some free time. And now you're going to give me a hand. Literally.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, there's something I still don't get. I'm absolutely positive Agent P got hit with the Go Home-inator. So why did he end up in Africa of all places?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sir, may I offer you one of my budget-saver hors d'oeuvres before you go on? It's an old family recipe. Strips of bologna and wadded-up white bread.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: Continuing, the Smells-Like-Hay-inator, no. The Universe-inator just hit this trash can. Nothing left but this smudge. (sniffs) That means it can only be...

Name: Carl
Dialog: (gasps) Doofenshmirtz just downloaded a blueprint. (reads the blueprint) "Anti-gravity fun launcher"? Sounds fishy. Let's run it through the anagram decoder. (sees the words "Evil Fanatic Hunt R Raygun" on the screen; gasps) Major Monogram!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, everyone. When the sensors stop detecting the presence of fleas, the doors will automatically open. Agents, prepare for flea fogging.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Or he could try to interfere with the droogen strudel tasting! Our entire economy depends on establishing trade with the Drusselsteinians!

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: Agent P... (Agent P picks up his bowling bag.) No, it's not bowling night! It's Doofenshmirtz. He's activated the -inator alert system. We think he may have returned to evil.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry sir. I was just down in your beautiful kitchen and your wife was making two sandwiches. And I got to tell you, they were de-lish!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Fine. Suddenly they all found out a way to settle their differences, and it wasn't long before a peace accord was drafted and signed.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: You fool! Without Agent P's paw print, I can't unlock the computer. And without the computer, I can't take over the Tri-State Area.

Name: Carl
Dialog: They're probably just trying to mislead us. Let's check the source. (looks at the Flynn-Fletcher file) Agent P's owners! They must be in league with Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I hope for your sake you're right. You know it's funny how no one's noticed a grand piano dangling precariously over our table.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (sighs) Okay, I'll see what I can do. And so, the merry band set off on their quest, to the foreboding sounds of minor chords. Better?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sir, I looked out the window at his building just now, and I saw the mysterious object was actually a bucket. A huge bucket.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (as Billy) Alas, you know my mysterious secret. (to the camera) Hello. Now that you know about one of our agents, please follow these OWCA guidelines.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: The only -inator we haven't ruled out, that we actually have, is the Go-Home-inator. Meaning Perry the Platypus is home!

Name: Carl
Dialog: We've analyzed the mud and there seems to be a large number of caffeine molecules in there. Along with some rain water.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: I will have that paw print! (Perry chatters) Those digits are mine! You're running out of room, Agent P. (Perry and Carl reach the X-shaped rock) Now, let's get this over with.

Name: Bad Future Carl
Dialog: Major Monogram, I've detected a temporal anomaly in quadrant four which means a time machine was recently used there.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Excuse me sir. (Holding up booklet entitled "Seismic Activity and Quakes - by Carl") I wrote my sophomore thesis on quakes and seismic events. If you want you can check out my website.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, listen. I got an idea. If we can get to the evacuation wing, we might be able to use one of the escape pods.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I just wanted to check to see if you— (freaks out) MAIA MITCHELL!!! I'm your biggest fan! Love your voice and your work!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I just solved a small ongoing accounting error. You kept putting decimal points where you needed to put commas.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: You're right! Perry, Monty, let's go rescue our agents! (They leave, but Major-in-Charge Carl tries it again with a different inflection in the mirror.) Let's go rescue our agents. Let's go... (Perry comes back with his hands on his hips.) Oh, I'm coming.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, if you can do that, maybe I can just forget to mention the whole "dating a sworn enemy's daughter" thing.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: You fool, what have you done? Ah! (at Perry) You may have escaped, but you're no match for my evil Flynn-Fletcher robots! (Maniacal Laugh)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Your wife said it'd be okay if I came up here and kept you company. Would that be all right? I brought a book!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Aren't you a little concerned, sir, about all the previous models being recalled due to mechanical failure?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Perhaps Sweary would want to try my steam-powered jetpack. It's very heavy and full of boiling hot water.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: (whispering) Psst! Agent P, down here! (Cut to reveal Major-in-Charge Carl hiding in a kennel. Agent P approaches him.) Is that goat still eating out of the inbox? (Perry nods.) It's a good thing I hid the outbox.

Name: Carl
Dialog: One minute, sir! Just finishing up my status update. "Carl's interning like there's no tomorrow!" Done.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Nevertheless, individually, your scores look promising, but there's still a big problem with teamwork.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And, Doofenshmirtz, you're lucky you're legally considered an ocelot, or you wouldn't be here at all!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Krill is a small shrimp-like creature that plays an important role in the diet of the humpback whale.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Follow the light. That's right. Now, you're going to have to do the entire training exercise again.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, no! His holographic projection has become mesmerized by his video image! I better shut it off.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Excuse me, sir. I believe horoscopes are meant for entertainment rather then to be taken as fact.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I estimate you got about three hours, give or take, before your bot goes smoke, boom, spaghetti.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, "A Sal Tuscany Christmas". You lucked out, Agent P. Your secret Santa has exquisite taste.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sir, they used to be considered rodents, but were reclassified in the early twentieth century.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, that means "talk to you later". If you scroll down, you can see that message was from me.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh-oh. (sees Monogram try on fake mustache) Major Monogram, we have a situation here. Mr. Fletcher got caught in the memory eraser!

Name: Carl
Dialog: From the top of another hill, a figure appears, a shaft of light shining off his auburn hair.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oops, sorry. (Puts the face back on.) Sometimes this happens. I'm still working out the bugs then. There, good as new.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Oh, no, no, Monty. I can't let you do that. That's...that's crazy! You're not even an animal.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes! If anything goes wrong, the Tri-State Area may have to sell off one of the state areas!

Name: Carl
Dialog: But we were able to find a Dutch to French dictionary, and a French to English dictionary.

Name: Carl
Dialog: ...showing up at Doofenshmirtz's, and no good can come from that. Get to the bottom of it. (Laughs)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, we're here for the 2-for-1 sidekick special... (does a secret handshake with Norm and the other guy) ...'cause, y'know, we're all sidekicks.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: No! He's locked me out of the mainframe! If he gets away, I'll never be able to take over.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: (checks his phone) Oh, looks like the name "OWCA" just became available! Oh, and so did their old building!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, boy. They're Agent P's owners, sir. Looks like they found one of our secret tunnels.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Glad to have you back, Agent P. You lost some time, but I brought along the escape cone. (Cut to the roof of the truck. The strawberry ice cream on top launches revealing a cone under it with Agent P riding it. When it becomes airborne, wings pop out of it. A monitor appears on the cherry.)

Name: Carl
Dialog: And if you push THIS button, it gives your adversary an incredible ice cream headache.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: Dendrobium uncharticum. Yep, we're in the right place. Fan out and find that platypus. (The robots do so)

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Yes! And all the animal agents are going crazy! (Monty opens the kennel and Major-in-Charge Carl crawls out.) Eh, on the upside, I've been promoted.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You can't shoot that at a suspect! Are you crazy?! It would blow them to smithereens!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off-screen) Uh, Sir? Hello? I didn't step on in time. Would you mind lowering the platform again?

Name: Carl
Dialog: As I was saying sir, I may have a solution. (presses a button, opening a garage) Anticipating just this kinda situation...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Major, I'm looking up Professor Parenthesis in our database. There's not much on him.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Gosh, sir. I've never been to a cadet graduation before. (Cut to inside the car to reveal Carl driving while Monogram and Perry are in the back.) I hope I'm not underdressed.

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, Maj—Er, Dad. I was just playing with my new friends. Sir, situation neutralized.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Very manly, sir. Did I mention I'm allergic to bug bites? Maybe we should turn back.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And he really just wants to spy on Monty to find out what kind of girl he's dating.

Name: Carl
Dialog: C'mon, pretty please? Pretty please with a cherry on top? I'll be your best friend!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes? What is it, Agent T? (Agent T shows him) Oh no, that's Candace Flynn of the Flynn-Fletcher family.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I don't understand all the itching. I handed out the new flea collars this morning.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'll start right now by triple-checking the chattosphere for suspicious activities.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Ugh! My first day on the job and all my agents get captured! W-What am I gonna do?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, Agent P doesn't have his hat tools. I took them out to clean and repair them.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wait, how would you know Agent P is near me unless you have a tracker in me, too?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, it never occurred to me that the emergency exit would be locked down, too.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I don't see why I can't be in this story. Besides, it's totally better this way.

Name: Carl
Dialog: But wait, listen to this. It's a seemingly innocent voice recording of Phineas. (plays the voice recording)

Name: Carl
Dialog: There's an entrance flap by my head. Maybe you can get into it to dislodge me.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Talking to Monogram via wrist communicator) Sir, I think Agent P is working for... Sir? (Sees Monogram about to eat cheese in a contest at Cheesetopia) No! Don't do it! Don't do it! (The cheese-eating contest begins and Monogram starts eating cheese and swelling up) No!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa, Agent P, stop right there! Shut it down! Stop the exercise!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I suppose... but, I was... just having so much fun sneaking around with you.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm not a stick, sir! I'm a person in the mud with feelings and mudskippers!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, Agent P. I was cleaning your lair and forgot to move your chair back.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, you're gonna have to pick it up a little, sir. They're starting to boo.

Name: Carl
Dialog: "Silly antics"? I've told you three times now! Those are my part-time jobs!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Did you want the ones with the triangles or the imitation paint splatters?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, maybe there is a way. What about Dr. Doofenshmirtz's Amnesia-inator?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) Oh, sorry, sir. I thought you were done. You want me to turn 'em back on?

Name: Carl
Dialog: But if we play all those syllables backwards in a random order, we get...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I've never gotten less than a gold star in my entire interning life.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm sorry, sir, he just comes in at the beginning. Shall I continue? (Major Monogram mumbles under his breath) Huh?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Alright. Well, now I'm confused. What did you think I thought it meant?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I didn't have to find him, we had a lunch date, he was waiting for me.

Name: Carl
Dialog: That reminds me, sir. O.W.C.A.'s business license expired last month!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I left him a message, sir. I think he went to Aruba for winter break.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: I needed Agent P out of the way, so I left you those drinking straws.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. (Carl pushes Lawrence out. The robot takes his "5" sign off and puts it on Lawrence.) Thanks, we gotta hurry! Off you go! (Pushes Lawrence through the bushes. Perry comes out of the butt again and Carl shakes his hand.) Nice work, Agent—

Name: Carl
Dialog: Don't judge yourself for this. This is not a measure of you as a man.

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, I'm not approving overtime. We'll do it without you day-players.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (looks at his watch) Oh, weasel-toes! I've gotta get into costume and get to my next job!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, should both my shoulders be dislocated from their sockets, sir?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, remember his last mission? You were pretty tough on him, sir.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: Evil Flynn-Fletcher robots, let's drop by the Flynn-Fletcher house.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I can't, sir! Rapids are fast! That's actually what "rapid" means!

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: Drink your smoothie, mustache man. (At Doofenshmirtz) And you, go unload my -inators.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, all I did was turn the cushion over. The stain was already...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, Agent P, I've got the surveillance tapes from earlier today.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes. Hello, Agent P. So, yeah, go ahead and put on that fruit hat.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: New recruits, huh? I see you want to do this the hard way. (He mimics a trumpet) Charge!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, she's our only hope. All our other agents are being dewormed.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Why are we wearing a fez in the middle of Central America anyway?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I'm an unpaid intern! How d'you think I afford to pay rent?

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: I'm evil, not uncivilized. Did you try the Madagascar chocolate?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh... (thinking) Say a cool name like Nitro, Dax or Steel. (to Phineas) My name is Carl. (groans)

Name: Carl
Dialog: That's okay, you probably weren't gonna get me anything, anyway.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, I'd be happy to. (tries to pick it up, then remembers it's a hologram. To Monogram) Seriously?! You don't remember this jerk?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, that's not important now! We need to find a way to escape!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, it was a typo. Doof isn't at the shark, he's at the park.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, whatever you're doing, sir, none of it is dislodging me.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I can handle things here, Agent P. You go after Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Monogram) Sir, I've gained their trust. (to Phineas) So, what kind of scheme is this?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Meanwhile, back at the cottage of the humble antique dealer...

Name: General Carl
Dialog: No, actually sir I think it's a dra... (Carl gets slapped by the dragon's tail) Oh, that kind of duck.

Name: Evil Carl
Dialog: Enough of your mindless prattle, minion! Show me my -inators!

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, no, I can't smell a thing, sir, I have no sense of smell.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I made it myself! (gasp) I'm gonna go print up some more! Yay! Hmhm! (leaves)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wow, who knew? Sure hope you didn't hit an innocent civilian.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yeah, before Doofenshmirtz juices City Hall in seven minutes!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, sir, he did separate his feet a little on the reentry.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I don't think our instincts can get us out of this one.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent D, would you mind? (lifts Agent D's flea collar and gets a flea with some tweezers) Hmm. Gotcha! Let me see something.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, Agent P. Gotta go. (gives Perry the laser pointer and the manual) Carry on. And remember! Teamwork!

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: I've been well. Guess who's just set off the -inator alert?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I'll become an acrobat if it'll make you proud of me!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, I've gotta get to my part-time job! I'm late for work!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Aw, come on, Dad, can't I just stay for five more minutes?

Name: Carl
Dialog: He also updated his social media status to "evil again".

Name: Carl
Dialog: Nothing yet, sir. We think they may have been scattered.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (entering, also dressed as Carmen) Sir, I found your dosimeter. It was—What are you doing?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Baljeet) So, I hear you're the math genius behind this operation.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, sir, but be careful. There's a huge set of stairs.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Luckily Sir, it looks like the residents were not home.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You keep pushing him down, but he keeps coming back up!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, I was looking for you so we could leave together!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, to be fair, sir, you do get paid more than we do.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Of course not sir. (He makes his way past Monty and Major Monogram) Pardon me. Excuse me. Coming through

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh wait sir, I found a picture of the actual princess.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Again, sir, there was nothing on the box to indicate--

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Yeah, that's how Agent Squab types, all hunt-and-peck.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wow! I think my career just took a giant step forward.

Name: Carl
Dialog: ...so I'll be giving you your assignment, okay? 'Kay.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Will you stop it? I am trying to have a conversation.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) He thinks two eyepatches make him look twice as cool.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, well. I got to find out what happened to Agent P.
